---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for OpenProcessor
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What problem does this solve?**
A clear description of the problem or use case. Prefer describing the
*problem* over a specific implementation — it's easier to find the
right design that way.

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like to see happen. If you have an API shape in mind
(new endpoint, new config field, etc.), sketch it here.

**Alternatives considered**
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've tried or considered.

**Scope**
- [ ] Core API (detect/faces/embed/OCR/ingest/query)
- [ ] Curation subsystem (experimental — `/curation/*`)
- [ ] Deployment / Docker / infra
- [ ] Documentation

**Additional context**
Anything else — links, screenshots, related issues.
